speech_text_raw: In extreme deficits without support help, marksman positioning and awareness are paramount.
normalized_text: In extreme deficits without support help, marksman positioning and awareness are paramount.

speech_text_raw: Maintain a positive mentality; defensive play can bridge the gold gap.
normalized_text: Maintain a positive mentality; defensive play can bridge the gold gap.

speech_text_raw: When clearing waves, track the enemy jungler (Wukong) to avoid being picked off.
normalized_text: When clearing waves, track the enemy jungler (Wukong) to avoid being picked off.

speech_text_raw: Don't over-commit to fights when significantly behind in items, even if a teammate engages.
normalized_text: Don't over-commit to fights when significantly behind in items, even if a teammate engages.

speech_text_raw: Focus high-priority targets with CC and coordinate with teammates for jungle resources.
normalized_text: Focus high-priority targets with CC and coordinate with teammates for jungle resources.

speech_text_raw: In teamfights, stay away from burst threats and save cleanse skills for critical CC.
normalized_text: In teamfights, stay away from burst threats and save cleanse skills for critical CC.

speech_text_raw: Use map pressure to force the enemy to react, but maintain awareness of flankers.
normalized_text: Use map pressure to force the enemy to react, but maintain awareness of flankers.

speech_text_raw: Prioritize wave management to prevent backdoors, especially when the enemy has the Overlord.
normalized_text: Prioritize wave management to prevent backdoors, especially when the enemy has the Overlord.

speech_text_raw: Capitalize on teammate's CC but be wary of extremely tanky targets.
normalized_text: Capitalize on teammate's CC but be wary of extremely tanky targets.

speech_text_raw: Use skills to scout bushes when vision is missing, especially near high-value buffs.
normalized_text: Use skills to scout bushes when vision is missing, especially near high-value buffs.

speech_text_raw: Late-game item swaps are crucial for survival during high-ground sieges.
normalized_text: Late-game item swaps are crucial for survival during high-ground sieges.

speech_text_raw: In 1v1 marksman duels, use the tower for protection and focus on clearing the minions first.

speech_text_raw: Avoid over-aggressive dives when the team is staggered; one death can end the game.
